subject: PrivMed - DPA redlines, SCCs & TIA coordination
messages:
From: Elena Varga <elena@privmed.solutions>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@privmed.solutions>, PrivMed Legal <legal@privmed.solutions>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines and TIA questionnaire for order form

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — PrivMed's legal & privacy team asked me to push on a few things before we get to signatures. Attaching our (fairly annotated) DPA redline and the Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) questionnaire. High level asks:

- We need the contract to clarify role allocation for certain subprocessor activities (analytics & monitoring). Our privacy officer prefers explicit ‘‘processor only’’ obligations with a single exception for telemetry.
- We require standard Schrems II-compatible SCCs to be attached; our counsel wants to see the proposed SCC Annexes and any alternate transfer mechanisms called out (we can't rely on vague language).
- We raised two narrow change requests about the Order Form data export clause (Section 3) and an audit evidence window (45 days).

Can you tell me who on Redwood will own the TIA responses and whether Redwood can provide a short evidence pack (log retention summary + list of subprocessor locations)? Also — is there a preferred template for execution (eSignature) or do you want us to circulate the DPA revision first?

Appended: PrivMed_DPA_Redline_v2.docx (redline), PrivMed_TIA_Questionnaire.xlsx

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our procurement deadline is 9/10.

Best,
Elena Varga
Head of Legal Ops
PrivMed Solutions

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena@privmed.solutions>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and TIA questionnaire for order form

Elena — thanks for the materials, received and reviewed at a high level. Looping in Monica (privacy evidence / compliance) and Rishi (contracts) so we can coordinate the response and evidence pack. Laura from Product has a quick question on the telemetry carve-out.

Quick answers:
- Owner: Monica will lead the TIA responses and assemble the evidence pack (log retention summary, subprocessor list with locations, and KV cache behaviour notes).
- SCCs: We will provide Redwood's standard SCC Annexes (latest EDPB-compliant text) and call out any deviations. If PrivMed insists on a specific Annex wording, we can track as a redline but need to understand rationale.
- Audit window: 45 days is a reasonable ask; Rishi please confirm if legal is comfortable adding it to the DPA (we prefer to keep the universe of audit triggers narrow — e.g., material incident or scheduled audit).
- Execution flow: we typically send a redline back for a single round of negotiation and then move to DocuSign. If you prefer, we can eSign earlier for SLA/Order Form items.

Next steps: Monica and Rishi will review line-by-line and aim to return a consolidated response with an evidence pack by 9/06 EOD. If any items require leadership approval (e.g., non-standard delegation of processor role), I'll escalate.

Karthik
Head of Privacy & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: PrivMed DPA redline + evidence checklist

Team — I pulled the DPA redline and started a gap checklist. High-level items I will cover in the evidence pack:

1) Retention / export controls: we can supply a one-page retention summary (S3 lifecycle + GCP snapshot policy) and note that export controls are governed by our contractual SCCs and regional routing.
2) Subprocessor list: up-to-date list with country of processing for each subprocessor (will call out analytics vendor in US and monitoring vendor in eu-west1).
3) KV cache & telemetry: Laura, can you confirm whether the telemetry data described in PrivMed's redline contains any PII? If not, we should offer a narrow telemetry exception (telemetry = runtime metrics only, aggregated).
4) Audit window: Rishi — proposed language: "Provider shall make available audit evidence and logs relating to a Customer's Data within 45 calendar days of a written request where the request relates to a specific, documented security incident or regulatory requirement." Keeps the 45-day SLA but ties it to discrete triggers.

I will assemble a zipped evidence pack (evidence_summary.pdf, subprocessor_list.csv, retention_summary.pdf) and send to Elena + legal by EOD 9/06. If anyone foresees a blocker on the SCC Annex we publish, flag now.

Attachments referenced: PrivMed_DPA_Redline_v2.docx (internal copy), PrivMed_TIA_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Varga <elena@privmed.solutions>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, PrivMed Legal <legal@privmed.solutions>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and TIA questionnaire for order form

Elena — quick update from our side following internal review:

- Monica will deliver the TIA responses and an evidence pack by Monday 9/06 EOD. Pack will include: retention_summary.pdf, subprocessor_list.csv, evidence_summary.pdf.
- SCCs: We attach Redwood's standard SCC Annex (EDPB-aligned). If PrivMed needs an alternate Annex, please mark the clauses in your redline and we will evaluate.
- Telemetry carve-out: Product confirms telemetry is aggregated runtime metrics (no PII). We propose this narrow definition be added to the DPA as an illustrative example, not an open delegation.
- Audit window: we can accept 45 days where tied to a documented incident or regulator request — proposed clause placed in our redline.

Please confirm: do you want us to return a consolidated redline (single file) or separate doc for SCC Annex + evidence pack + redline? We will do whichever shortens cycle.

Also sharing a HubSpot deal note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/PM-4392 (for procurement). Once we have PrivMed sign-off on the annex/telemetry language we'll route the final DPA + Order Form to DocuSign.

If you want a call to close items quickly, I can make time Fri 9/03 11:00–12:00 PT.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy & Legal Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments included: evidence_summary.pdf (stub), retention_summary.pdf (stub), subprocessor_list.csv (stub)
